reporting-org.narrative: Siasa Place (SP) is a civic-tech youth-led non-governmental organization (NGO), established in 2015 that specializes in working with grassroots youth, in building institutional structures to support youth participation in politics and good governance. SP targets youth (men and women aged 18 to 35 years) and develops their skills in policy review, supporting the creation of youth-friendly platforms for public participation in decision-making processes, including the budget process and social accountability. SP works in 12 counties including Uasin Gishu, Kakamega, Busia, Kisumu, Homa Bay, Migori, Kericho, Nakuru, Nairobi, Kitui, Lamu, and Mombasa.

title.narrative: Strengthening the Power of Youth Voices Annual Report October 2022 - Sept 2023

description.narrative: In October 2022, Siasa Place in partnership with the Centre for Multiparty Democracy (CMD-Kenya) initiated a multi-annual Strengthening the Power of Youth Voices (SPYV) project whose goal was to contribute towards realization and sustenance of young people’s civic and political rights. The project was implemented with support from the Embassy of the Kingdom of Netherlands (NL) in Kenya. The intended outcomes of the project were four-fold: (a) Safe and institutionalized spaces for dialogue between youth and with all relevant government institutions and political actors created; (b) Youth are more aware and internalized democratic values, rule of law, gender-sensitive and inclusive politics; (c) Youth civic actors that voice and monitor youth’s interests at national and county levels and (d) Formal and informal youth groups/organizations have the capacity and legitimacy to influence government, business and social and economic development. Interventions at the output and activity levels were geared towards realization of these outcomes and the overall project goal. After one year of successful implementation of the project, this report details the progress made, results achieved and challenges experienced over the first year (October 2022 - September 2023). Both SP and CMD-Kenya collectively contributed towards realization of each of the project outcomes.

participating-org.narrative: A project steering committee was formed with representatives from Nairobi, Busia, Homa Bay, Kericho, Lamu, and Kitui counties, including officials and youth leaders. It established one office of the citizen and in progress of getting space for another office in a different county, where so far four petitions have been drafted and served for actions to relevant public offices.

activity-date.narrative: The program established secure and institutionalized spaces for youth dialogue with government institutions and political actors. Through the Inception meetings and community forums the program enabled youth to engage leaders that lead to the formation of county-based committees. The program further created social media leadership platforms in counties, identifying active groups, bloggers, and Influencers. These leaders will coordinate civic education and social media campaigns in their areas. .

recipient-country.narrative: The Strengthening the Power of Youth Voices initiative is currently being carried out in Kenya, East Africa region in the following counties, Nairobi, Busia, Homa Bay, Kericho, Lamu, and Kitui
